sourceEdition: Effective Fall 2023, current official AP Central CED retrieved 2026-10-13
scope: 35 topics and six practices. Every topic has at least introductory practice, but no topic is claimed comprehensively covered. Classifications describe the listed modes, not every objective or essential-knowledge item. No topic is marked Reinforced: unrestricted explanation and authentic project work remain teacher-reviewed.
